fieldValues.title: muSrs: the identity record is not yet a reading guide
fieldValues.summary: muSrs opens on a 216-character identity record; a reader is not told what the five areas are or where to start.
fieldValues.body: The restructure into five areas has been recovered and is in muDemocracy.org#408: reachability rises from 67% to 93%. Write the reading guide on top of it, and overview documents for the newly reachable sections (31 of 75 are documents).
